title: feat: persist sanitized external generation evidence
body:
## P5 follow-up — external generation history

Stacked after PR #24 (`completion/model-library-followup`); PRs #17–#24 remain draft.

- persists successful external-generation evidence through a versioned SQLite migration and immutable content-hash records
- stores provider/model identity and confidence, network disclosure, usage, estimated/actual cost, budget decisions, and dated price snapshot only
- keeps prompt text, returned text, API keys, credential blobs, and headers out of storage/history/export paths
- exposes typed desktop history reload and a usable Settings history surface; browser preview remains read-only
- validates with 82 TypeScript tests, 105 Rust tests, typecheck, Vite build, cargo fmt/check/test, and diff checks via canonical BL4 app_server
- no real provider or external network call was made by CI/tests

P5 remains IN PROGRESS pending native Tauri/WebView acceptance, opt-in real-provider smoke, security review of the complete flow, and remote CI/publication checks.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
